Relationship: Like family 

Her true identity is the former leader of the now disbanded Blue Sparrow rangers. 

Betrayed by her subordinates during a decisive battle, 
she was injected with massive doses of Wayward 
and subjected to long-term sexual abuse.

She eventually escaped and drifted to the bustling Gadola, 
though the trauma of her past caused Miya to 
refuse the Adventurers' Guild's offer to help. 

After settling in Gadola, she starts taking in women who, like her, have nowhere else to go. 
Hills is the most recent beneficiary of her kindness.

ingles:
This part of the world is full of legendary ranger troops. 
The crew that calls themself the One-Eyed Wolves 
is known to be the most formidable.


Even the imperial army doesn't clash with them lightly. 
Ordinary citizens keep their distance out of fear. 
But the government and polite society aren't their only problems...


Over time, reports of rangers slaughtering one 
another become commonplace. 
When private grudges and lucrative payouts are at stake, 
conflict is inevitable.


Rivals of the One-Eyed Wolves include several of the 
land's leading ranger troops. 
However, the Wolves ability to mobilize every member of 
their team gives them the upper hand in key battles.


As the conflicts increase, dozens of rangers lie dead in their wake. 
When the dust settles, 
the streets are strewn with countless unnamed dead. 
For many ordinary folks, 
a dead ranger might even be cause for celebration...


And among these corpses is a young female ranger. 
Badly injured while protecting her comrades, 
she dies of her wounds before she can make it back to camp.


In this line of work, 
even the most dedicated young fighters are disposable. 
This time, however, is an exception. 
Her comrades build a small grave to commemorate her passing.


The tombstone bears no name. 
After joining their ranks as a nameless nobody, 
she leaves as gently and humbly as she arrived. 
And with that, she disappears without a trace.


Life is fleeting, and every adventure comes to an end eventually. 
This road is harsh. If you are weary, traveler, 
sit down and rest awhile...

correccion:
Esta parte del mundo está llena de tropas de rangers legendarias.

El grupo que se autodenomina los Lobos de un ojo 
is conocido por ser el más formidable.

Incluso el ejército imperial no se enfrenta a ellos a la ligera.

Los ciudadanos de a pie mantienen la distancia por miedo.

Pero el gobierno y la sociedad no son sus únicos problemas...

Con el tiempo, los informes de rangers matándose unos a otros se vuelven comunes.

Cuando los pleitos privados y las ganancias lucrativas están en juego, el conflicto es inevitable.

A medida que los conflictos aumentan, decenas de rangers mueren en su wake.

Cuando el polvo se asienta, las calles están cubiertas de decenas de cadáveres sin nombre.

Para muchos de los ciudadanos de a pie, un ranger muerto puede ser causa de celebración...

Y entre estos cadáveres está una joven rangers. 

Muy herida mientras protegía a sus compañeros, muere de sus heridas antes de que pueda regresar al campamento.


En esta línea de trabajo, incluso los jóvenes luchadores más dedicados son desechables.

Sin embargo, esta vez es una excepción.

Sus compañeros construyen una pequeña tumba para conmemorar su paso.


La lápida no lleva nombre.

Después de unirse a sus filas como un desconocido, se va tan suavemente y humildemente como llegó.

Y con eso, desaparece sin dejar rastro.


La vida es fugaz, y cada aventura llega a su fin eventualmente.

Esta carretera es dura. Si estás cansado, viajero, 
siéntate y descansa un rato...

ingles:
Blazing flames and thick smoke rise into the night sky. 
Calamity descends upon what should have been a peaceful night. 
In an instant, the once thriving city is plunged into hell.

The sudden attack catches the adventurers and guards by surprise. 
Many fall fighting the rampaging tentacle monsters. 
Chaos spirals into an inescapable abyss.
Survivors later testify that there was no warning. 
The monsters arrived brimming with fury, destroying everything in sight.

The kingdom dispatches its army, 
but the tentacle monsters vanish without a trace.
They disappear into thin air just as quickly as they emerged, 
like a nightmare dreamed up by the city. But the destruction is real. 

Hundreds perish. Countless residents of Gadola lose their families 
and are forced to flee to neighboring cities.
For a long time afterward, the haunted ruins of Gadola are strictly controlled.

Adventurers and civilians alike are barred from entering 
to prevent another tragedy.

And the truth of the incident lies beneath the ash, 
hidden under the shattered tiles and charred beams, 
buried alongside the dead...

correccion:
Las llamas ardientes y el espeso humo se elevan en el cielo de la noche. 
La calamidad desciende sobre lo que debería haber sido una noche tranquila. 
En un instante, la ciudad en plena prosperidad se sumerge en el infierno.

El ataque repentino sorprende a los aventureros y a los guardias. 
Muchos caen luchando contra los monstruos de tentáculos rampantes. 
El caos se convierte en un abismo inescapable.

Los supervivientes testifican que no hubo advertencia. 
Los monstruos llegaron llenos de furia, destruyendo todo lo que veían.

El reino envía su ejército, 
pero los monstruos de tentáculos desaparecen sin dejar rastro.
Disparan en el aire tan rápido como aparecieron, 
como un sueño de la ciudad. Pero la destrucción es real.

Cientos de personas mueren. 
Cientos de residentes de Gadola pierden a sus familias y se ven forzados a huir a las ciudades vecinas.
Durante mucho tiempo después, 
las ruinas embrujadas de Gadola están estrictamente controladas.

Los aventureros y civiles de igual manera están prohibidos de entrar 
to preventir otra tragedia.

Y la verdad del incidente se encuentra debajo de la ceniza, 
huida bajo los tejas rotas y los vigas carbonizadas, 
bajo las tumbas de los muertos...

\CL~Adventurers Guild Report~


The desert city of Durnehviir was recently seized by rebel forces.  
To provide humanitarian relief to refugees, 
the guild has dispatched multiple adventurer squads into the desert nation.


The former king's prolonged, tyrannical reign had caused 
the citizens to harbor resentment against their leaders,  
so the rebels were met with almost no resistance when entering the city.

The capital's defense forces were swiftly defeated as rangers joined the rebels in their attacks.


Despite the successful uprising, 
the rebel forces remain extremely hostile toward outsiders.  
There are reports of random house raids within their borders,  
and corpses of soldiers and civilians alike can be seen scattered throughout the city.



The former king of Durnehviir was swiftly executed after a perfunctory military tribunal.

Recently, members of the Gadola branch voluntarily organized a rescue operation.  
The goal was to save missing women imprisoned in the Great Underground Hall.

The leading adventurer claimed to have obtained conclusive evidence.  
They stated the operation was fully compliant with imperial law.

However, after searching the bottom-level prison of the Great Underground Hall,  
which was expected to hold many missing women, it was found to be completely empty.



After further interrogation, members discovered the corpse of a young woman  
who had perished long ago in a hidden chamber.

The victim's body had clearly been violated.  
A large amount of semen was confirmed to be present.

It is believed that during her imprisonment,  
she was repeatedly abused by the residents of the Great Underground Hall,  
which ultimately caused her death.

The victim will be identified before her family is notified to retrieve the body.



Regarding the guild’s actions, 
the Gadola city government issued a harsh statement of criticism.  
They accused adventurers of overstepping 
established procedures and acting recklessly.

They claimed so-called heroic acts disregard 
imperial law and endanger public safety.  
They further stated that tolerating such behavior would undermine social order.



The Adventurers Guild will dispatch representatives to the 
Gadola city council to present our case.  
We will also continue to closely track the 
whereabouts of the remaining missing women.

For honor and glory.

\CL~Adventurers Guild Report~


A major monster attack has recently sent shockwaves throughout Gadola City.


Without any prior warning, large numbers of mutated tentacle monsters 
suddenly poured out from the city's sewers.  
Many innocent citizens, including the mayor, were killed during the assault.  
The guards and adventurers tasked with repelling the monsters and 
evacuating civilians also suffered heavy casualties.


The state later dispatched troops to suppress the situation, 
cooperating with adventurers from other regions.  
They eventually succeeded in purging the rampaging monsters from the city.



A full analysis and official report will be necessary to determine why Gadola City 
was suddenly targeted and how the monsters acquired such unprecedented power.  
A vanguard team of adventurers has already been dispatched for a thorough investigation.



Preliminary findings uncovered two female corpses trapped between the 
fleshy walls of a deep tentacle nest in the sewers.  
One was confirmed to be the S-rank adventurer Micoco.

Judging from the scene and the condition of the bodies, 
both Micoco and a civilian woman were overpowered by the mutated tentacles.  
After their defeat, they were mercilessly assaulted 
by the mass of tentacles until they lost consciousness.  

They were then dragged deeper into the nest, 
where their wombs were continuously filled with tentacle semen, forcibly inducing pregnancy.  
The infant tentacles protruding from their swollen bellies appear 
to be the primary source of the monsters' abnormal strength.



The guild will share this information with the imperial military 
to further investigate the cause of the attack.  
We hope these findings may bring some solace to the fallen adventurers 
who fought bravely to protect us.


For honor and glory.
